title: Jets get some good injury news on Adonai Mitchell

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets get some good injury news on Adonai Mitchell
sources.description: Starting wide receiver Adonai Mitchell hasn’t played for the team since Week 2. He suffered a finger injury prior to the team’s game against the Detroit Lions. Mitchell is set to return to the lineup this Sunday when the Jets take on the Miami Dolphins. Running back Breece Hall and left guard Dylan Parham will […]
